sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Madico has been a leader in high-quality manufacturing for over 120 years, producing window films and specialty coatings for automotive, architectural, and safety applications.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Tampa Bay, Florida, USA · Size: <$50M · Products: Black Pearl Window Tint, ClearPlex, SafetyShield G2, Sunscape, ProtectionPro, ViewScape

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Madico, Inc. scores 23 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for application fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, graffiti resistance, chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar's low-surface-energy face makes graffiti and overspray wipe off cleanly. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (56% similar on films, protection, window, performance); Mactac (35% similar on films, specialty, protection, film); ORAFOL Europe (30% similar on films, performance, automotive, long-term). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
